name: 6 mm D-shaft (knob / potentiometer shaft)
notes: Common 6 mm D-cut shaft for pots and appliance knobs, specified as '6 x 4.5 mm' (flat 1.5 mm deep). Values from distributor search snippets (Tayda 'D shaft 6 x 4.5 mm' knobs, Mouser Davies knobs '6mm Flat to 4.5mm', Alps RK12L 'cut depth 1.5mm'); pages blocked or 404 on fetch. Some knobs are listed as 4.6 mm; design the bore ~4.6-4.7 for a press fit.

name: NEMA 17 stepper motor (1.8 deg, typical)
notes: From Schneider Electric/IMS M-17 drawing: 4x M3x0.5 holes on 30.99 (1.22 in) square, pilot dia 22.0 +0/-0.052, shaft dia 5 with D-flat 4.52 +/-0.05 (flat ~19 mm long), shaft length 23.88 +/-0.51. NEMA nominal 1.7 in = 43.2 mm face; many generic motors (e.g. 17HS4401, 40 mm body) list 42 mm and 21-24 mm shafts, and some use 4-40 UNC instead of M3.

name: NEMA 23 stepper motor (typical)
notes: Hole spacing 47.14 sq (1.856 in; NEMA bolt circle 2.625 in), pilot 1.500 in, pilot depth 1.6, shaft 0.250 in from NEMA size tables; 56.4 face and 20.6 shaft length from Accu-Components NEMA23-76 listing (search snippet, page 403). Clearance hole ~5.0-5.2 mm (0.195-0.205 in). 8 mm shaft variants exist but were not verified; body length varies 41-112 mm.

name: 40 mm fan (e.g. Noctua NF-A4x10)
notes: 40x40x10 (NF-A4x10); 40x40x20 also common (NF-A4x20). Holes on 32 mm square, measured horizontally not diagonally. Mounting hole diameter not verified (typically ~3.3-3.5 mm for self-tapping screws).

name: 60 mm fan (e.g. Noctua NF-A6x25)
notes: 60x60x25 (NF-A6x25); 60x15/60x10 slim versions exist. Holes on 50 mm square. Mounting hole diameter not verified.

name: 80 mm fan (e.g. Noctua NF-A8)
notes: 80x80x25 (NF-A8 PWM; 81x81x27 with anti-vibration pads per Noctua). Hole spacing 71.5 mm per Wikipedia and Noctua (search snippet); QuietPC FAQ rounds to 72. Hole diameter not verified (typ. ~4.3-4.5 mm).

name: 92 mm fan (e.g. Noctua NF-A9)
notes: 92x92x25 (NF-A9 PWM); 92x14 slim version (NF-A9x14) uses same 82.5 spacing. Hole diameter not verified (typ. ~4.3-4.5 mm).

name: 120 mm fan (e.g. Noctua NF-A12x25)
notes: 120x120x25 (NF-A12x25); 15 mm slim versions exist; some industrial (Delta) 120 mm fans are 25.4 or 38 mm thick. Holes 105 mm square. Hole diameter not verified (typ. ~4.3-4.5 mm).

name: 140 mm fan (e.g. Noctua NF-A14)
notes: 140x140x25 (NF-A14 PWM). Holes 124.5 mm square; many 140 mm fans also have 105 mm holes for 120 mm mounts (not verified here). Arctic P14 lists a 143x143x29 envelope.

name: Levoit Core 300 / 300S filter (Core 300-RF)
notes: Cylindrical 3-stage filter; airflow RADIAL: air enters through the cylinder side (360 deg intake around the base of the unit) and exits up through the centre hole/top. Size 7.6 x 7.6 x 5.8 in from a compatible-filter listing (other listings 7.5 x 5.7-5.75 in); centre-hole diameter not found. CADR 143 cfm and unit 22x22x36 cm from Levoit's Core 300-P page.

name: Levoit Core 400S filter (Core 400S-RF)
notes: Cylindrical bonded HEPA+carbon filter, radial airflow like the Core 300. Size ~9.3 x 9.3 x 10 in from third-party listing search snippets only (Best Buy page timed out, Staples blocked; Best Buy lists height 9.92 in). CADR 247 cfm (AHAM dust) from HouseFresh. Centre-hole diameter unknown; measure before relying on it.

name: Desktop thickness (IKEA LAGKAPTEN)
notes: IKEA LAGKAPTEN 140x60 table top is 3.4 cm (1 3/8 in US) thick; US 55 1/8 x 23 5/8 in. Solid-wood (18-25 mm) and standing-desk top (25-30 mm) ranges were not verified.

name: Wall stud spacing and drywall
notes: US residential: 16 in OC standard, 24 in OC for some walls; studs 1.5 in wide, 3.5/5.5 in deep. 1/2 in (12.7 mm) gypsum per USG (snippet). EU metal-stud (CW) walls: max 625 mm OC with 12.5 mm board per Heinze/DIN 18182 (snippet); 600 mm also common.

name: US single-gang wallplate (NEMA WD 6)
notes: Standard and jumbo per Archtoolbox (WD 6 sizes); 2-gang standard 4.5 in wide. Leviton calls 3.50 x 5.25 in 'oversize' (snippet), so jumbo height varies 5.25-5.5. Midway 3-1/8 x 4-7/8 from Leviton listing titles (snippet). Device-to-box screws 3-9/32 in (6-32); toggle plate screws 2-3/8 in; duplex plate uses one centre screw.

name: EU (Schuko) single frame and flush box
notes: Frame from Gira Standard 55 1-gang (80.7 sq; other brands ~80-81 mm). 68 mm round flush box (DIN 49073, withdrawn) with insert screws 60 mm apart; depths 40-60 mm.

name: UK single-gang plate (BS)
notes: 86 x 86 mm 1-gang plate on 60.3 mm fixing centres (MK blanking plate); fits standard 25-35 mm 1-gang back boxes.

name: Kitchen drawer front heights (IKEA SEKTION/METOD + MAXIMERA)
notes: US SEKTION 24x24x30 in base with 3 drawers uses 24x5, 24x10, 24x15 in fronts. EU METOD 60x60 base (frame 80 cm) uses 2x 20 cm + 1x 40 cm fronts (inferred from 60x20/60x40 front packages); a 10 cm low front also exists but was not verified.

name: IKEA KALLAX 2x2 shelf unit (77x77)
notes: Inner compartment per IKEA HK fits inserts up to 33.5 x 39 x 33.5 cm (often quoted as 33 x 33 cm); outer 76.5 x 39 x 76.5 cm. Divider/panel thickness not published.

name: US kitchen countertop height
notes: 36 in floor-to-top is the US convention (34.5 in cabinet + 1.5 in top); not set by building code. ADA accessible 28-34 in. Desk height (29-30 in, BIFMA) not verified.

name: US plywood nominal vs actual thickness
notes: Actual = 7/32, 11/32, 15/32, 19/32, 23/32 in (23/32 in = 18.26 mm exact; table rounds to 18). Always measure: import/hardwood ply varies.

name: Baltic birch plywood (metric)
notes: Sold in metric thicknesses; 3 mm ~1/8 in, 6/12/18 mm slightly under 1/4, 1/2, 3/4 in. Standard sheet 60 x 60 in (5x5 ft). Per-thickness actuals not published; measure stock before cutting slots.

name: Cast acrylic sheet thicknesses (ISO 7823-1)
notes: Min/max = ACRYLITE cast tolerance band. US '1/8 in' is sold as 3.0 mm (0.118), '3/16' as 4.5 mm, '1/4' as 5.5 mm (0.217, Acme) or 6.0 mm (0.236); typical tolerance +/-10%, often <5%. Measure for laser-cut tabs.

name: MDF sheet (standard)
notes: UK stock thicknesses on 2440 x 1220 sheets; 3 mm also sold (range 3-36 mm, tolerance +/-0.15 per another supplier). US 1/2 and 3/4 in MDF not verified.
